stages.title: Download your chat plugin
stages.instruction: This ZIP is configured for your business. Download it and keep it zipped.

stages.title: Open your WordPress administration
stages.instruction: Confirm the HTTPS address where you manage WordPress, then open its plugin-upload screen.

stages.title: Upload your chat plugin
stages.instruction: In WordPress, choose Upload Plugin, select machines-cloud-install-ui-1-1440.zip, then choose Install Now.

stages.title: Activate your chat plugin
stages.instruction: When installation finishes, choose Activate Plugin. Then return to this page.

stages.title: Check your published website
stages.instruction: We’ll check your published website for this workspace’s chat, then confirm a sample customer request reaches your Inbox.
